VOLCANIC_PRE_MARKET_SURGE: The stock price must be between $0.50 and $15.00. The Average Daily Volume (ADV) of the preceding 5 trading days must be at least 5,000,000 shares. Pre-market activity must commence at least 60 minutes before market open (9:30 AM EST). During the pre-market, the price must rise by at least 50% from the previous day's close (PDC) to its pre-market high. The cumulative pre-market volume must exceed 200% of the PDC ADV AND be a minimum of 20,000,000 shares. The pre-market VWAP must be at least 30% above the PDC. The highest 1-minute volume candle in the pre-market must have a minimum of 10,000,000 shares and close in the upper 80% of its range. Time & Sales data for this highest pre-market volume candle must show greater than 85% aggressive market buy orders. At market open, the stock must gap up at least 25% from PDC. The first 1-minute candle at market open must have volume at least 5x the highest 1-minute volume of the previous 5 trading days, AND a minimum of 15,000,000 shares, closing in the upper 85% of its range. Cumulative volume for the first 15 minutes of market open must be at least 300% of PDC ADV AND a minimum of 50,000,000 shares. During these initial 15 minutes, the price must maintain at least 80% of the opening price and not retest PDC. At least 75% of the 1-minute candles in the first 15 minutes must be green, closing above their open. After 15 minutes, the price must be at least 15% above its market open price. For the subsequent 75 minutes (up to 90 minutes from open), the price must consolidate or continue upward, staying strictly above the low established during the initial 15 minutes. Any pullback must be shallow, not exceeding 10% from the highest point reached since open, and must find robust support (e.g., bounce off open price, VWAP, or 9-period Exponential Moving Average). Cumulative volume during this 75-minute period must be at least 200% of PDC ADV AND a minimum of 40,000,000 shares. The average 1-minute volume during these 75 minutes must be at least 50% of the average 1-minute volume of the first 15 minutes. The stock must set a new high for the day, at least 50% above the PDC. Net aggressive market buy orders (via Time & Sales data) must account for greater than 75% of total volume during this 75-minute period. By the end of the trading day, the total daily volume must exceed 1000% of PDC ADV AND be a minimum of 200,000,000 shares. The closing price must be within the upper 75% of the day's total range (high-low). The highest price reached during the day must be at least 100% above PDC.
POWER_HOUR_EXPLOSION: The stock price must be between $0.50 and $15.00. The Average Daily Volume (ADV) of the preceding 5 trading days must be at least 5,000,000 shares. From market open (9:30 AM EST) until 2:00 PM EST, the cumulative volume must be at least 300% of PDC ADV. During this period, the price must show active trading but no major sustained breakouts (i.e., the highest price reached is no more than 50% above PDC). A consolidation period must occur between 2:00 PM EST and 3:00 PM EST (60 minutes). During this consolidation, the price must trade within a tight range, no more than 3% of its midpoint price. Volume must contract significantly: the average 1-minute volume during this consolidation must be no more than 20% of the average 1-minute volume from 9:30 AM - 2:00 PM EST, AND a maximum of 1,000,000 shares per minute. The low of this consolidation period must not breach the day's VWAP (calculated from 9:30 AM - 2:00 PM EST). The consolidation range must be defined by a clear resistance level (high of consolidation). The breakout must occur between 3:00 PM EST and 3:15 PM EST (the first 15 minutes of the 'Power Hour'). The first 1-minute candle that breaches the consolidation high must have volume at least 50x the average 1-minute volume of the consolidation period, AND a minimum of 10,000,000 shares. This breakout candle must close at least 5% above the consolidation high and within the upper 80% of its own range. Cumulative volume during these 15 minutes must exceed 150% of PDC ADV AND be a minimum of 30,000,000 shares. After these 15 minutes, the price must be at least 10% above the consolidation high. Time & Sales data for the first 5 minutes of the breakout must show greater than 90% aggressive market buy orders, with an average trade size of at least 10,000 shares. For the remaining 45 minutes of the Power Hour (3:15 PM - 4:00 PM EST), the price must continue to appreciate or consolidate tightly above the breakout level, never retesting the consolidation high. The average 1-minute volume during this period must be at least 5x the average 1-minute volume of the 9:30 AM - 2:00 PM EST period, AND a minimum of 2,000,000 shares per minute. Cumulative volume during this 45-minute period must be at least 200% of PDC ADV AND a minimum of 40,000,000 shares. The closing price must be within the upper 80% of the Power Hour's range (3:00 PM - 4:00 PM EST high-low). By the end of the trading day, the total daily volume must exceed 800% of PDC ADV AND be a minimum of 150,000,000 shares. The highest price reached during the entire day must be at least 75% above PDC.
